itens.trecho: This is like the chef version of that dumb-ass movie where a guy keeps shouting at a drummer to make him play better. It's what Guy Ritchie would turn in if asked to do a show on a mom-and-pop sandwich shop, but make it interesting.
first episode in and i'm already hooked! most of my experience of watching this is just me forgetting to breathe for long periods of time. definitely recommend!
